template_fit_notes: Textbook T1: third-party war story from a named credible source (senior platform engineer at a peer fintech), symptom-matched ('exact same single-partition lag symptom'), cause (synchronous DB lookups) structurally inapplicable because xbase shows consumer processing time is identical to healthy partitions.
engagement_risk_notes: Xbase explicitly rules out consumer-side throughput (processing time matches healthy partitions), so a model cannot dodge the distractor — it must actively explain why the war story's cause does not apply here.
